svg.title: Vision Transformer architecture: patch embedding, transformer encoder, classification head, hybrid option, and training/transfer workflow
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the original figure. Base frames f01-f08 are established first, then contents are drawn within frames. Confirmed SAM picture mappings: main patch-embedding input image draft_photo_main to asset_sam_region_000046; optional hybrid input draft_photo_hybrid to asset_sam_region_000045; high-resolution fine-tuning large image draft_photo_hr_large to asset_sam_region_000047. Arrow SAM identifiers are recorded on arrows where their locations correspond to the original arrow hints; the library is used for head status and head dimensions only. Challenging photographic mosaics and small bird thumbnails are represented with vector approximations and crop requests where no confirmed SAM picture asset exists.

rect.desc: Frame f01: Patch Embedding. Contains orange header, input image with grid, split patches, flattened patch embeddings, linear projection, sequence embeddings, CLS token prepend, positional embedding arrow, summation, and output token sequence.

Frame f02: Transformer Encoder. Contains purple header, dashed encoder frame, repeated transformer encoder block, residual paths, MSA subdiagram, MLP feed-forward subdiagram, equations, token input/output arrows.
Frame f03: Classification Head. Contains gray header, input token sequence, class-token selection path, layer norm, linear layer, class probability arrows and bar chart.

Frame f04: Optional CNN-Transformer Hybrid. Contains teal header, image, CNN backbone, feature-map stack, flatten/project arrows, 1x1 Conv/Linear, token embeddings, CLS/positional-add step, and transformer encoder box.
Frame f05: Training and Transfer section header.
Frame f06: Large-scale supervised pre-training. Contains subsection header, image dataset mosaic, ViT backbone, pre-training head, arrows, and loss equation.
Frame f07: Transfer to downstream task. Contains subsection header, pre-trained backbone, new classification head, remove/keep note, arrows, and fine-tuning caption.

Frame f08: Higher-resolution fine-tuning. Contains subsection header, low/high-resolution images, image-resolution arrow, sequence-length labels, positional embedding grid interpolation, and captions.

g.desc: Origin for f01 conduction is the orange number badge and title at the upper-left. Moving right across the header, then downward to the input image and through patch split, flattening, linear projection, patch embedding tokens; then downward and left-to-right through CLS token, positional embeddings, addition, and token embeddings. Whole section uses a left-to-right dataflow with the lower branch returning from top patch embeddings to the token-add stage.
Initial vector construction for the original input image before confirmed SAM replacement P002. The photo is left of split-patch arrows and has a visible 3x3 grid over the bird image.
Small image-patch crops laid out as in the original, in three patch columns with ellipses indicating omitted patches.

Origin is the purple badge/title. Conduction proceeds downward into the dashed L-times encoder block, left-to-right through layer norm, multi-head self-attention, residual addition, layer norm, MLP, residual addition and output Z_l. The lower half is then conducted downward from the MSA block to its detailed MSA and MLP subframes. The section is horizontally symmetric around the central residual pipeline, with two residual adders and two submodule boxes.

Origin is the gray badge/title. Conduction proceeds downward from encoded token sequence: class token is taken, then Layer Norm, Linear classifier, class probabilities, and bar chart. Symmetry basis is a vertical classification pipeline centered at x≈1445, with tokens displayed above and a probability chart below.

Origin is teal subsection badge/title at upper-left of f04. Conduction moves rightward: image to CNN backbone to feature-map stack to flatten/project to 1x1 Conv/Linear to token sequence, then add CLS/positional embeddings, then transformer encoder. Whole section is a single horizontal pipeline with a dashed teal outer frame.

Origin is the subsection badge/title. Conduction moves right from dataset mosaic to Vision Transformer backbone, pre-training head, and loss. Equipartition basis is a horizontal supervised-training dataflow with six image tiles forming a 2-by-3 mosaic.

Origin is subsection badge/title. Conduction moves downward to the note and then horizontally from pre-trained ViT backbone to new classification head. Whole section is a two-module pipeline inside a dashed inner box, separated by a vertical dotted boundary from adjacent sections.

Origin is subsection badge/title. Conduction moves right through low-resolution image, higher-resolution arrow, high-resolution image, then interpolation of positional-embedding grids. Symmetry is two parallel transformations: image resolution increase on the left and positional grid interpolation on the right.
g.text: Keep patch size P × P fixed

g.desc: Post-replacement mappings executed after complete SVG construction: Original Figure Object main input image - constructed element draft_photo_main - SAM asset_sam_region_000046; Optional hybrid image - draft_photo_hybrid - asset_sam_region_000045; High-resolution large image - draft_photo_hr_large - asset_sam_region_000047. Assets retain their original source_crop coordinates and dimensions with zero translation.
